title: Block Ads on RTVE, Atresplayer, Mitele, laSexta | AdOff
description: AdOff neutralises video ads on RTVE, Atresplayer, Mitele and laSexta, plus Portuguese RTP, TVI and SIC. Free browser extension, no account required.
h1: Ad Blocker for Spanish Catch-Up TV: RTVE, Atresplayer, Mitele
answer: AdOff removes pre-roll and mid-roll ads from Spanish catch-up TV platforms in the browser, in most cases. It replaces the Google IMA ad SDK their players request with a stub that immediately resumes the programme, so replays on RTVE or Atresplayer run without interruptions. The same applies to Portuguese services while they keep the standard player integration.

sections.h2: What happens when you press play
body: Normally the player downloads the IMA SDK and runs a break before and during the programme. With AdOff active, the SDK request is redirected to a bundled stub. The player asks the stub to start the ad, the stub answers "content resume requested", and playback continues as if the break had already finished. Everything happens locally in the browser; the video stream itself is not modified.

sections.h2: Public broadcaster and commercial groups, same entry point
body: RTVE is public, Atresmedia and Mediaset España are commercial — yet their browser players converge on the same ad SDK. That shared dependency is why one extension can cover all of them with a single mechanism. It also explains the contrast with subscription streaming, where ads are stitched into the stream server-side and the extension stays out by design.

AdOff also runs 180 static network rules blocking ad and tracking domains, plus a cosmetic CSS/DOM filter that hides banners and promotional overlays. On rtve.es or atresplayer.com this clears promo tiles and billboards from the page, so the catalogue is cleaner before you even choose a programme.

• If a platform adopts server-side ad insertion (SSAI), the ad is part of the stream and the stub no longer applies.
  • AdOff works in the desktop browser only: RTVE or Mitele apps for mobile and smart TV are out of scope.
  • Some live broadcasts and sport use different pipelines.
  • Players change often; coverage is maintained by the project rather than fixed forever.
AdOff is a Manifest V3 extension, entirely free, with no account and no trial. It runs on Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge and Opera. Install it from the official site and keep protection toggled on.

faq.q: Does AdOff block ads on RTVE?
faq.a: In most cases yes: when the RTVE web player loads advertising through the Google IMA SDK, AdOff substitutes a stub that resumes the programme immediately. Live streams and sport may use different pipelines where results vary.

faq.q: Can I skip the ads on Atresplayer for free?
faq.a: AdOff is a free browser extension that neutralises the ad SDK in the Atresplayer web player, so pre-rolls and mid-rolls usually do not play. Atresplayer Premium is a separate commercial product; AdOff does not interact with your account.

faq.q: Does it also work on Portuguese channels like RTP?
faq.a: Yes. RTP, TVI and SIC are covered by the same mechanism when their browser players request the standard ad SDK. The coverage list includes both the Spanish and Portuguese markets.

faq.q: Does it work on the Mitele app or a smart TV?
faq.a: No. AdOff is a desktop browser extension only. Native mobile apps, smart TV apps and casting sessions are outside its reach.

faq.q: Is anything about my RTVE or Atresplayer account affected?
faq.a: No. AdOff runs locally, does not log into anything and does not modify requests to the broadcaster's content servers — only the ad SDK script is substituted.

cta.h3: Replay español sin cortes de publicidad
cta.p: Install AdOff and let the stub handle the ad SDK on RTVE, Atresplayer, Mitele and laSexta.
